J2.evidence: The entry «قال أبو إسحاق: لِيُعْجِزَهُ لتفوته ...» glosses «لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ» which occurs in 35:44 «وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍ». It is listed under the right ayah; the gloss لتفوته is a complete, translatable statement and both readings render it with the ellipsis. Placement needs no change.

J1.evidence: «قال أبو إسحاق: لِيُعْجِزَهُ لتفوته ...» glosses «لِيُعْجِزَهُ» of 35:44 «وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ». It is listed under the right ayah; the ellipsis is a truncation in the source, but the surviving text is placeable and is translated as it stands in both readings.
